name: Daniela Reyes
title: The Mechanic
ability:
[reaction] After an enemy attacks you (except an attack of opportunity you provoked), even if that attack was canceled: Either deal 1 damage to that enemy, or automatically evade it.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If you were attacked by an enemy this round, you automatically succeed, instead.
ability_cn:
[reaction] 在一名敌人攻击你后(除了你引起的趁乱攻击外)，即使该攻击被取消：对该敌人造成1点伤害，或自动躲避它。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。如果你本轮被敌人攻击过，改为你自动成功。
elder_sign: [elder_sign] effect: +1. If you were attacked by an enemy this round, you automatically succeed, instead.
elder_sign_cn: [elder_sign]效果：+1。如果你本轮被敌人攻击过，改为你自动成功。
flavor_text: "Relax, tough guy. I'll handle this. You stand over there and look pretty."
back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Mechanic's Wrench, Mob Goons, 1 random basic weakness.
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：守卫者([guardian])等级0，求生者([survivor])等级1-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，最多5张其它的求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：机修工扳手、黑帮暴徒、1张随机基础弱点。
